about: Where gear is worn and what each place accepts (I03a, D-game-35, inventory-plan 3.4). Each group is a row: code never names a group, it follows the flags, so a seventh group is one more row here. A group has either `slots` (named body slots; the item's `wear` must equal the slot's name) or `count` with a `wear` kind (that many identical slots). `accepts` lists the item tags the group takes (an item with any of them fits). `layer` is where the avatar draws the group (1 under, 2 over, 3 looks only; left out for a group that is not a layer), `noDuplicates` allows one of a kind in the group, and `statsApply` says whether the worn items give their stats (false for the cosmetic layer). `labels` (or `label` for counted slots) is the Spanish noun the equipment panel (I04) names the slot with; a slot with no label waits for a word the lexicon has. `bagSlots` is the inventory with no bag worn (the hotbar's 10 and 20 more); a worn bag adds its `capacity` (items.json), and a bag with items in the slots it adds cannot come off (I03b). The order of the groups and of their slots is part of the bundle: commands and the digest carry indexes.
